brief_summary: Horizontal spectrum with two warm-grey anchor points: FR4 on the left ('softer, quieter — the familiar quiet anchor') and aluminum on the right ('stiffer, brighter — the familiar bright anchor'). A coral-highlighted callout sits above the spectrum's midpoint, connected by dashed brackets to both anchors, labeled 'carbon fiber — Volcano's bottom plate: stiffer than FR4 by a meaningful margin, lighter than aluminum' with a note underneath reading 'doesn't map cleanly onto the aluminum-vs-FR4 spectrum'.
